synopsis: Lord Kinnock's full title is The Rt Hon. the Lord Kinnock. His name is Neil Gordon Kinnock, and he is a current member of the House of Lords.

history.heading: Chronic Obstructive Pulmonary Disease
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what steps they are taking to establish clear clinical pathways for chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) care and ensure wider, more equitable, and accessible use of COPD biologics in relevant cases.
history.answeringBodyName: Department of Health and Social Care

history.heading: Utilities: Nationalisation
history.questionText: To ask His Majesty's Government what consideration they have given to establishing and taking a golden share in public benefit companies to exercise accountable public control of essential utilities, including water and sewage.
history.answeringBodyName: Department for Environment, Food and Rural Affairs
